name: Flame Tongue Rapier
entries: While holding this magic weapon, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|SRD52} and use a command word to cause flames to engulf the damage-dealing part of the weapon. These flames shed {@variantrule Bright Light|SRD52} in a 40-foot radius and {@variantrule Dim Light|SRD52} for an additional 40 feet. While the weapon is ablaze, it deals an extra {@damage 2d6} Fire damage on a hit. The flames last until you take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|SRD52} to issue the command again or until you drop, stow, or sheathe the weapon.

name: Frost Brand Glaive
entries: When you hit with an attack roll using this magic weapon, the target takes an extra {@damage 1d6} Cold damage. In addition, while you hold the weapon, you have {@variantrule Resistance|SRD52} to Fire damage.
In freezing temperatures, the weapon sheds {@variantrule Bright Light|SRD52} in a 10-foot radius and {@variantrule Dim Light|SRD52} for an additional 10 feet.
When you draw this weapon, you can extinguish all nonmagical flames within 30 feet of yourself. Once used, this property can't be used again for 1 hour.
